_comments: THE NIGHTLY OVERLAPPING-SUBSCRIPTION CHECK (golive #279, finance exception type 5). MJ's scheduler
dispatches Actions, not operations, so this row is the adapter to `Orders.DetectOverlappingSubscriptions`;
the class behind it holds no detection logic.
SAFE TO SHIP `Active`: nothing invokes it until the ScheduledJob in `metadata/scheduled-jobs/` is
enabled, and a run by hand only adds review items, never changes an order or a subscription.

fields.Name: Detect Overlapping Subscriptions
fields.Description: Raise a finance exception for each pair of live subscriptions for one holder whose terms overlap. Runs the Orders.DetectOverlappingSubscriptions operation, which reads the OVERLAPPING_SUBSCRIPTION exception type's settings, runs the Overlapping Subscriptions query and raises through accounting; this Action only reads parameters and reports the result. A pair that could not be raised fails the run and is named in Errors.
fields.UserPrompt: Check for subscriptions that overlap for the same holder and raise them for finance review.

fields.Name: AsOfDate
fields.Description: The business day the exceptions are dated to (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for today in the business time zone, which is what the schedule uses. A value that cannot be parsed is refused rather than replaced with today.

fields.Name: TypeActive
fields.Description: False when the OVERLAPPING_SUBSCRIPTION exception type is missing or inactive, in which case nothing was checked.

fields.Name: ExceptionDate
fields.Description: The business day the exceptions were dated to.

fields.Name: PairsFound
fields.Description: Overlapping pairs the query returned, before the IncludeSameCategory setting is applied.

fields.Name: AlreadyRaised
fields.Description: Pairs that already had an exception from an earlier run, in any status. They are left unchanged.

fields.Name: Errors
fields.Description: Every pair that could not be raised, with the reason. Non-empty means the run failed.
